signal: Hitachi Rail announced an agreement to acquire Clever Devices in April 2026, opening a path to expand its products globally.

email.body1:
Michael, saw the Hitachi Rail agreement to acquire Clever Devices, with the path to take your transit products global.

Going global usually means a far wider account map than the business development team can cover before territories and partners settle, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for your strategic accounts off hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit the global number
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up on the global expansion ahead.

New markets usually expand the target list faster than the team can work it. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to cover the new geography, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your strategic business development needs to cover that expansion, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for your team.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to peer transit-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the acquisition closes, no problem at all. Deal quarters carry their own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic business development motion? I'll tailor it to Clever Devices either way.
